PMEX · Revenue Operating System for Healthcare

Security & Compliance

Built to HIPAA Standards, From the Ground Up

A platform that touches billing, patient communication, CRM and legal case coordination has to be trustworthy in every one of those places at once. Security on the PMEX Portal isn't a single feature bolted on, it's a set of controls applied consistently across every part of the system.

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Access is controlled by role. Every action leaves a trail. That's the baseline, not an upgrade tier.
